No option can be put forward yet: the run could not check your under‑4% monthly churn limit or evaluate the £20k MRR threshold in the model’s outcome frame.

- The price comparison itself was moderately robust under the tested variations, but that is not a verdict on meeting both of your stated conditions.
- The comparison is particularly dependent on **Active Pro subscribers**; its source is not recorded. Non‑Pro MRR was also defaulted to £0 because no starting value was supplied.
- The modelled churn constraint needs to be attached to the part of the model it governs before it can be checked; simply restating “under 4%” will not resolve that.
